_comment: CO2 factors (SPEC §15), g CO2e per passenger-km, well-to-wheel, keyed by country. Source for SE: IVL Swedish Environmental Research Institute, 'Typvärden för klimatpåverkande utsläpp från långväga personresor i Sverige', report U11173, May 2026 (commissioned by SJ AB); electric car: Trafikverket rural WTW value, excludes vehicle manufacturing. Values as given in SPEC.md §15; re-check against the report before any public launch.
